source: Source: Audemars Piguet; Watches by SJX

slides.headline: Not window glass. Metal.
slides.body: The polished bezel and centre links are a metal called bulk metallic glass.

slides.headline: Why it's called glass
slides.body: It's a palladium alloy cooled in seconds, so it hardens like glass, not like normal metal. Pd500 on the back marks the palladium.

slides.headline: Built to stay shiny
slides.body: It's very hard to scratch, so AP left it mirror-polished next to brushed titanium and a smoked red dial.
